title: Ali's Food
text:
Ali likes breakfast very much. Every morning, he eats bread, cheese, and an egg. He drinks a glass of milk with his breakfast. Ali says breakfast is the most important meal of the day.

For lunch, Ali often eats rice and chicken. He eats vegetables too, like carrots and tomatoes. After dinner, he likes to eat a small apple. Ali thinks fruit is a good snack.

questions.text: What does Ali drink with his breakfast?
What does Ali often eat for lunch?
Which food does Ali probably think is healthy?
How does Ali probably feel about food?
options: He enjoys eating many kinds of food
He does not like to eat
He only wants to eat one food

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
plants such as carrots and tomatoes that we eat as food
the sweet part of a plant, such as an apple, that people eat
a small amount of food eaten between main meals

paragraph_translations: Ali kahvaltıyı çok sever. Her sabah ekmek, peynir ve bir yumurta yer. Kahvaltısında bir bardak süt içer. Ali kahvaltının günün en önemli öğünü olduğunu söyler.
Öğle yemeğinde Ali genellikle pilav ve tavuk yer. Havuç ve domates gibi sebzeler de yer. Akşam yemeğinden sonra küçük bir elma yemeyi sever. Ali meyvenin iyi bir atıştırmalık olduğunu düşünür.
